definitions.gloss: first dan; first-degree rank (martial arts, go, shogi)
definitions.explanation: The first and lowest {段|だん} (dan) rank in martial arts, go, shogi, and similar disciplines, reached after clearing the {級|きゅう} (kyū) grades. In martial arts it corresponds to the first-degree black belt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{初段|しょだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I earned first dan in judo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧{初段|しょだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧だ。
examples.english: He has the skill of a first-dan in kendo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て、ようやく⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{初段|しょだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After years of practice, I was finally certified at first dan in calligraphy.

notes:
{初段|しょだん} is the entry-level ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ rank in martial arts, board games (go, shogi), and traditional arts. ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ ranks count upward ({初段|しょだん} → {二段|にだん} → …), so {初段|しょだん} is the start of the higher ranking system, reached after the ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ grades.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧: kyū — the grades below ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧; these count downward toward {一級|いっきゅう}
- {二段|にだん}: second dan — the next rank up
- ⟦{黒帯|くろおび}→黒帯：14938_kuroobi⟧: black belt — worn from {初段|しょだん} in many martial arts
